title: Junior AI Software Engineer
description:
Our client is looking for Junior AI Software Engineers to join their growing engineering team and build AI-powered products and applications. This is an ideal opportunity for software engineers with 2-4 years' experience who have started working with Generative AI, LLMs or AI applications and want to develop their career further in AI.
Key Responsibilities: Build and maintain AI-powered applications, APIs and services. Develop scalable backend and full-stack software. Integrate LLMs, AI APIs and third-party services. Contribute to RAG, AI agents and agentic workflows. Work with cloud technologies, primarily Azure. Use modern engineering practices including Docker, Git, testing and CI/CD. Collaborate with senior engineers, AI specialists and product teams.
Requirements: 2-4 years' commercial software engineering experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field. Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Java. Experience with APIs, backend development and modern software engineering practices. Exposure to cloud platforms, Docker and CI/CD. Genuine interest in Generative AI and AI application development.
Desirable: Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel. RAG, LLM or AI agent development. React / TypeScript. Kubernetes. Azure AI services.
